choice: dock-setup.sh sets a resume binding and, while its auto_resume is false, prints the one-time step: right-click in the 'Linear server' tab, Resume Commands, Edit, save, Auto-Restore. Approvals are signed per command prefix, so a later CLI binding of the same command is already trusted.
context: After a cmux relaunch the Dock layout comes back but processes do not, so the helper would stay down.
rejected: Enabling auto-restore from the CLI: bindings set by CLI or socket are always manual and never prompt. Settings, Terminal, Resume Commands: it only lists approved prefixes.
title: cmux reruns a resume command after a relaunch only once the user approves it in the UI
